title: JPL manager: life on Mars means death for JPL

tellings.quote: said one of the managements people had said at Jet Propulsion Lab, um, they were talking about finding life on Mars and one manager had scolded the rest of the managers saying, "Don't you realize that life on Mars means death for JPL?

plain: Managers at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, the NASA lab that builds and flies space probes, were once talking about finding life on Mars, and one of them scolded the rest: "Don't you realize that life on Mars means death for JPL?" Michels passes this on as something the writer Whitley Strieber told. The point of the story is that the lab itself might have a reason not to find life there.
